 EUR/USD: Elliott Wave Analysis and Forecast for 13.11.26–20.11.26 Alex Geuta https://www.litefinance.org/blog/authors/alex-geuta/ The article covers the following subjects:
 Major Takeaways 
 Main Scenario 
 Alternative Scenario 
 Analysis 
 Major Takeaways
 Main scenario: Consider short positions from corrections below the level of 1.1254 with a target of 1.0895–1.0728. A sell signal: the price holds below 1.1254. Stop Loss: above 1.1299, Take Profit: 1.0895–1.0728.
 Alternative scenario: Breakout and consolidation above the level of 1.1254 will allow the pair to continue rising to the levels of 1.1446–1.1650. A buy signal: the level of 1.1254 is broken to the upside. Stop Loss: below 1.1209, Take Profit: 1.1446–1.1650.
 Main Scenario
 Consider short positions from corrections below the level of 1.1254 with a target of 1.0895–1.0728.
 Alternative Scenario
 Breakout and consolidation above 1.1254 will allow the pair to continue rising to the levels of 1.1446–1.1650.
 Analysis
 On the weekly time frame, an ascending wave of larger degree B is developing, with wave (A) of B forming as its part. On the daily time frame, the third wave 3 of (A) is apparently unfolding. Within it, wave i of 3 has formed and a downward corrective wave ii of 3 is still unfolding. Wave (c) of ii is forming on the H4 chart, with wave v of (c) developing as its part. If the presumption is correct, EUR/USD will continue to decline to the levels of 1.0895–1.0728. The level of 1.1254 is critical in this scenario as a breakout above it will enable the pair to continue rising to the levels of 1.1446–1.1650.
 This forecast is based on the Elliott Wave Theory . When developing trading strategies, it is essential to consider fundamental factors, as the market situation can change at any time.
